title: Bagel's No Tool Breakage
description: Stops 1 durability tools from mining blocks.
body:
Prevents you from fully breaking Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, Hoes, Swords and Shears by giving you the maximum level of Mining Fatigue when a 1 durability tool is held.

Saves you from accidentally breaking your tools, making it easier to repair them in an anvil and makes it more viable to use the faster golden tools.

Compatible with all enchantments including Unbreaking and Mending.

Supports Multiplayer.

Made for Java 1.21.6.
